name: OSS_USAGE_MESSAGES
description: Following table is used to capture PriceUsages message.

columns.name: USAGE_MESSAGE_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture message indentifier for usage rating.

columns.name: PARTITION_KEY
columns.description: Unique Identifier for the partition.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_MESSAGE_NAME
columns.description: Parameterized error message indicating the specific error

columns.name: MESSAGE_TOKEN1_NAME
columns.description: Column indicating the name of the token used in FND Message.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TOKEN1_VALUE
columns.description: Column indicating the value of the token used in FND Message.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TOKEN2_NAME
columns.description: Column indicating the name of the token used in FND Message.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TOKEN2_VALUE
columns.description: Column indicating the value of the token used in FND Message.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TOKEN3_NAME
columns.description: Column indicating the name of the token used in FND Message.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TOKEN3_VALUE
columns.description: Column indicating the value of the token used in FND Message.

columns.name: PARENT_ENTITY
columns.description: Field used to capture parent entity populated for usage rating.

columns.name: PARENT_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture parent entity id populated for usage rating.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Tracks the batch id for given usage message.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TEXT
columns.description: Field used to capture message text populated for usage rating.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TYPE
columns.description: Field used to capture message type populated for usage rating.

columns.name: MESSAGE_NAME
columns.description: Field used to capture message name populated for usage rating.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
